entities.summary: Ola Oni (1933–1999) was a Nigerian marxist political economist, socialist and human right activist. He served as a lecturer at the University of Ibadan. He was the subject of a biographical book by Ebenezer Babatope, titled Student Power in Nigeria (1991).
